name: adaptive-engineering
description: Project-first engineering with code simplicity rules and explicit learning to a local knowledge vault.

interface.longDescription: Inspect existing project patterns before coding, debugging, refactoring, or review. Keep changes simple and validate them with focused checks. Explicit learn requests save candidate knowledge and GitHub references to a configured local vault. Requires filesystem access and Python for helper scripts; vault setup is separate.
defaultPrompt: Find the closest existing implementation for this task and make the smallest coherent change.
Learn this material and save a concise candidate note to my configured engineering vault.
